intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for PipelineSliceFixtures. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Test-support unit for the end-to-end request-path slice (lives under src/test): static helper holder with the two table members above, used by the slice test. Boundaries of the test code only; no production behavior. THE END-TO-END REQUEST-PATH SLICE: @SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = RANDOM_PORT) with the test profile, WebTestClient driving POST /api/v1/telemetry/packets against the embedded H2 substitute executing the REAL migrations, asserting DURABLE rows: (1) valid heart-rate packet -> 202, one telemetry_sample row VALID, audit_trail rows with correlation_id equal to the X-Request-Id response header; (2) HR 300 packet -> 202 (NOT rejected) and a row tagged VALIDATION_FAILED with the raw value kept; (3) the same packet re-sent (at-least-once retry) -> still one row for the identity (device, metric, t_device) and no extra event_revision; (4) a packet whose t_device is 120 seconds older than arrival -> a telemetry_sample row plus event_revision row with revision_no 1 and an APPEND_REVISION audit row; (5) body with blank deviceId -> 400 and no rows written. Poll with reactor-test/awaitility-free bounded retries (no Thread.sleep) because the History stage runs asynchronously from the validated stream.

methods.signature: static String packetJson(String deviceId, String sourceKind, String metric, long tDeviceEpochMillis, double value)
methods.semantics: Builds one single-object JSON body for POST /api/v1/telemetry/packets.

methods.signature: static Mono<Long> countRows(DatabaseClient client, String table)
methods.semantics: SELECT COUNT(*) of the given table; table must be one of telemetry_sample, event_revision, audit_trail (IllegalArgumentException otherwise).
